units.source_text: 我将身边的坐垫和包袱皮团成一团，挟在胳肢窝下，站起来朝金阁望了望。

en.t: I bundled the cushion and wrapping cloth beside me into a single lump, tucked it under my arm, stood up, and looked toward the Golden Pavilion.

units.source_text: 金光闪闪的梦幻的金阁开始朦胧了。

en.t: The dreamlike Golden Pavilion, glittering with gold, began to blur.

units.source_text: 栏杆渐渐被黑暗所吞噬，林立的柱子变得模糊不清了。

en.t: The railings were gradually swallowed by the darkness, and the rows of pillars grew indistinct.

units.source_text: 水光消失，屋檐内侧的反光也消去了。

en.t: The gleam on the water vanished, and the reflected light beneath the eaves faded away as well.

units.source_text: 不久，细部也完全隐没在黑夜中，

en.t: Before long, even the details were completely hidden in the night,

units.source_text: 金阁只剩下黑xuxu的朦朦胧胧的轮廓。

en.t: and all that remained of the Golden Pavilion was a dark, hazy outline.
